subject: C41
required_fixes: R1 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/api-client.tsx:126 accepts document results without checking whether their load is still current. Independently reproduced with the real ApiClient in jsdom: select B and then C while both openRequest observations are pending; resolve C, then B. C remains selected but its editor, Send and response pane disappear because the late B result replaces doc and followed.current prevents reloading C. Acceptance: obsolete document results cannot replace the current selection or resurrect closed documents/collections. Add a deferred-result regression resolving C before B and assert C stays usable; retain the existing new-draft/stale-snapshot regression.

R2 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/api-client.tsx:123 marks a selection followed before its load succeeds, while the callback at :128 ignores refused and undelivered results. Independently reproduced both a refused load and a rejected observation when selecting B: the editor stays blank and the operation's error is not displayed; selecting B again dispatches selectTab but does not retry openRequest. Acceptance: expose the failed load's reason and an explicit recovery action that can reopen the same selected tab after recovery, without an automatic retry loop. Cover both a refused result and an observation/delivery failure.

R3 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/tools-sheet.tsx:35 delegates failures to ApiClient.run, whose only error display is the background alert at apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/api-client.tsx:283. The shell makes that background aria-hidden and inert while the sheet is open (v2-shell.tsx:404). Independently reproduced an invalid cURL import: the refusal text exists only inside aria-hidden background content, with no exposed alert or error in the Import dialog. The same routing affects environment/schema/tool failures. Acceptance: present action failures accessibly inside the active sheet while preserving entered work and focus; add a component regression asserting the error is exposed while the dialog remains open.
limitations: Independent checks used the actual TypeScript/React modules transpiled in memory with jsdom and synthetic callbacks; no application files were changed, product endpoints called, or credentials accessed. The tools-error reproduction used the shell's same modal background-hiding behavior. The latest multi-transfer cancellation remediation passed independently: both active runs rendered, each cancellation targeted its own ID, and no extra send occurred.
